helpBet: bet <amount> [QU]    place the ante (an equal Super Bonus comes with it)
helpPlay: play <multiplier>    place the play bet (3x needs a pair of aces or better)
helpFold: fold                 fold, losing the ante and the Super Bonus
notQualifiedLine: note: dealer does not qualify (below king). Ante pays 1:1, play pushes
hintNone: There is nothing to advise right now
acesOrBetter: a pair of aces or better lets you raise to the cap
marginal: king high or better is worth the minimum raise
fold: not even king high, so the odds are against you
